definitions.explanation: The sale of goods in large quantities, typically to retailers rather than directly to consumers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卸売|おろしう}り⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧だ。
{卸売|おろしう}り⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It's cheap because you can buy at wholesale prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{築地|つきじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卸売|おろしう}り⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My father has worked at the Tsukiji wholesale market for many years.

notes:
USAGE:
Contrasts with {小売|こう}り (retail). Often seen in compound forms like {卸売|おろしう}り⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (wholesale market) and {卸売|おろしう}り⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (wholesaler).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卸売|おろしう}り⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (wholesale market)
- {卸売|おろしう}り⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (wholesale price)
- {卸売|おろしう}り⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (wholesaler)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小売|こう}り: retail — selling in small quantities directly to consumers
